name: Miwon Commercial Co., Ltd.
summary: Miwon Commercial Co., Ltd. manufactures and markets various chemical products in South Korea and internationally. The company offers personal care ingredients, including anionic, cationic, nonionic, and amphoteric surfactants; hair and conditioning fixative; resins; household surfactants, plasticizers, and UV stabilizers; and cosmeceutical active ingredients.
